p.i: Hac ille fidens toxica (subdola Gentis latentes insidias) cauet.

Hac ille securus feroces Sape minas gladiosq; fregit Authore suo Præfule[?] quum furor: Non ante visus frena licentia Laxauit ardenti per urbes Effera quum laniena Francas Graffata, Gentes terruit insolens.

Quum turba veri conscia Numinis, Incauta, fallacisq; dira Fraude ruit iugulata pacis: Et sacra Christo pectora credito Mactauit[?] atrox carnificum manus Passim, nec imbelli iuuenta Virginibus puerisq; parcens.
Quum luctuoso Gallia classico Lymphata cives diripuit suos, Fusoque cunctas Innocentum Sanguine conscelerauit vrbes.
Sic quae celebrant Orgia Manades Bacchantur acres, tympana quum crepant. Penthea sic damnis Agaue Laeta suis genitrix trucidat.
Sed te benignus Caelituum fauor Per tela & hostes, Optime Principum, Seruauit ereptum furentes, Auxiliumq; feret perenne.

page.notes: Verse lines are run together within each sentence-stanza; the printed line breaks are not kept. Stanza divisions follow the sentences. "Præfule" and "Mactauit" are doubtful readings. Otherwise the text is clear.
